deals.title: Apple AirPods Pro 3
deals.blurb: Apple's current flagship earbuds, with stronger noise cancellation, heart-rate sensing for workouts and Live Translation. NBC Select's tracking has Amazon's price at its lowest yet.
deals.label: Top pick
write_up: AirPods Pro 3 are Apple's current flagship earbuds, and this is the deepest cut on them we've seen during Black Friday week. NBC Select's price tracking puts Amazon's price at the lowest it has recorded, and both NBC Select and TODAY found Amazon cheaper than Target and Best Buy on the same model this week.

The upgrades over the AirPods Pro 2 are real rather than cosmetic. Apple says the noise cancellation removes up to twice as much noise, the buds now read your heart rate during workouts, and Live Translation works in conversation when paired with a recent iPhone. Battery life is rated at up to eight hours with noise cancellation on, and the box includes five ear-tip sizes, which matters more for comfort than any spec sheet.

Before you buy, check that the listing says AirPods Pro 3 and that it is shipped and sold by Amazon rather than a third-party seller. If you don't care about noise cancellation, the regular AirPods 4 at Walmart cost much less and are fine for calls and podcasts.
deals.who_for: iPhone owners who commute, fly or work somewhere loud.
deals.skip_if: You use Android, or you only need earbuds for the occasional call.

deals.title: Apple AirTag (2nd generation)
deals.blurb: The new AirTag has a louder speaker and longer range, and can share a lost bag's location with airlines. TODAY cites price tracking calling this its lowest price. Check whether you're buying the single or the four-pack.
deals.label: Stocking stuffer

deals.title: Kasa Smart Plug Mini 15A, 4-pack (EP25P4)
deals.blurb: The least glamorous smart-home upgrade and the one you'll use most. Works with Alexa, Google, SmartThings and HomeKit, tracks energy use, and is small enough not to block the second outlet.
deals.label: Easy upgrade

deals.title: Shark FlexStyle Air Styling and Drying System
deals.blurb: A hair dryer that twists into a styling wand, with auto-wrap curlers that spin both ways. The Airwrap idea at a much friendlier cost. Several bundles exist, so check which one the deal covers.
deals.label: Gift idea
write_up: The Shark FlexStyle is the hair tool to look at if you like the idea of a Dyson Airwrap but not the bill. A dryer head twists into a styling wand, and the two auto-wrap curling barrels spin in opposite directions, so you can curl both sides of your head toward or away from your face without switching hands.

Shark says it checks the air temperature a thousand times a second to limit heat damage, and at just over a pound and a half it's light enough to hold up through a full blowout. It's marketed for straight, wavy, curly and coily hair, and it comes in several different bundles.

That last part is the catch. Amazon lists versions with anywhere from four to seven attachments, so check exactly which bundle the deal applies to before you buy, and skip any listing that isn't sold by Amazon or Shark. It is corded, which is normal for a dryer but worth knowing if you hoped to style away from an outlet. If you only need fast drying and straightening, Walmart's simpler Shark Glossi costs less and does less.
deals.who_for: Anyone who blow-dries and styles most days and wants one tool instead of three.
deals.skip_if: You air-dry and only style for special occasions.

deals.title: LEGO Ideas Polaroid OneStep SX-70 Camera (21345)
deals.blurb: A life-size LEGO model of the classic instant camera. Press the red shutter and a little illustrated photo slides out. TODAY cites price tracking calling this its lowest price. A gift for grown-ups, not kids.
deals.label: Gift idea
write_up: This is the gift for the adult who already owns enough candles. The LEGO Ideas Polaroid OneStep SX-70 is a 516-piece, life-size model of the classic instant camera, and TODAY cites price-tracking data calling this its lowest price yet on Amazon.

The clever part is that it works like the real thing, sort of. Press the red shutter button and one of three illustrated LEGO photos slides out of the front. The set also comes with a booklet of interviews with the fan designer who pitched the idea and the LEGO designers who finished it, which makes it a good pick for photography nerds and design fans as much as for LEGO collectors.

At 516 pieces it is a manageable build, so it suits someone new to adult LEGO sets as well as a regular builder. It's rated 18+ and made for a shelf, not a playroom, and to be clear, it doesn't take pictures. Check the set number, 21345, so you get the right model and not a lookalike.
deals.who_for: Photography fans, design lovers and adults who like a calm evening build.
deals.skip_if: You're shopping for a child, or for someone who wants a camera that actually shoots.

deals.title: Levi's Men's 505 Regular Fit Jeans
deals.blurb: The straight, roomy Levi's that has outlasted most fashion trends. Sizes run wide, including Big and Tall, across more than twenty washes, but the deal varies by size and color, so check yours.
deals.label: Wardrobe staple

deals.title: Stanley Quencher H2.0 FlowState Tumbler, 40 oz
deals.blurb: Yes, that tumbler. Handle, straw, three-way lid and a lot of ice-holding. NBC Select's tracking puts it at its lowest price on Amazon. The discount may not cover every color.
deals.label: Ends Nov 30

deals.title: Roborock Q7 M5+ Robot Vacuum and Mop
deals.blurb: Fine, it's another robot vacuum. It's also a self-emptying one with LiDAR mapping and a tangle-resistant brush, and NBC Select's tracking has it at its lowest price on Amazon.
deals.label: Editor's pick
write_up: Fine, it's another robot vacuum. It's also one of the better-value self-emptying models this season, and NBC Select's price tracking has it at the lowest price it has seen on Amazon. The dock empties the robot into a sealed 2.7-liter bag, which Amazon says lasts seven to nine weeks between changes.

It maps your home with LiDAR, so it cleans in tidy rows instead of bouncing off furniture, and you can mark rooms and no-go zones in the app. Roborock lists suction at 10,000Pa, and the main brush is designed to resist tangling, which is the difference between a robot you use every day and one you rescue from pet hair every other day. It also mops, with three water-flow settings.

Treat the mopping as a bonus for light upkeep on hard floors rather than a replacement for a real mop on sticky spills. Check the model name on the listing says Q7 M5+, because Roborock sells several similar-looking Q-series robots and the cheaper ones skip the self-emptying dock.
deals.who_for: Pet owners and busy households who want floors kept tidy between proper cleans.
deals.skip_if: Your home is mostly thick rugs or has lots of steps between rooms.

deals.title: Apple AirPods 4
deals.blurb: The everyday AirPods, sold and shipped by Walmart itself. Good for calls and podcasts, with a USB-C case. This is the version without noise cancellation, so check the listing if you want that.
deals.label: Ends Nov 29

deals.title: Ninja SLUSHi 72 oz Frozen Drink Machine (FS300)
deals.blurb: A slushie machine that freezes the drink itself, no ice or blender, and keeps it frosty for hours. Absolutely unnecessary, and the hit of every summer party. The purple option is pre-owned.
deals.label: Rollback

deals.title: Oral-B iO3 Electric Toothbrush
deals.blurb: A pressure sensor that lights up when you scrub too hard, a two-minute timer and a travel case. Budget for iO replacement heads, which are the only kind that fit.
deals.label: Ends Nov 29

deals.title: De'Longhi Linea Classic Espresso Machine
deals.blurb: A straightforward 15-bar espresso machine with a steam wand for milk drinks. No built-in grinder, so bring pre-ground coffee or your own grinder.
deals.label: Ends Nov 29

deals.title: Nothing Headphone (a)
deals.blurb: Noise-cancelling headphones with a ridiculous battery rating of up to 135 hours, and a look that is not another black oval. Newer and less proven than the Sony pair below.
deals.label: Long battery

deals.title: Sony WH-1000XM5 Noise-Canceling Headphones
deals.blurb: Last year's Sony flagship, now a Doorbuster because the XM6 replaced it. The noise cancelling and comfort are still near the top of the class, so the older model is the smart buy.
deals.label: Doorbuster
write_up: The WH-1000XM5 is no longer Sony's newest headphone, and that is exactly why this deal is worth a look. The WH-1000XM6 replaced it, so Best Buy has made the XM5 a Doorbuster that runs through Saturday, November 28 at 11:59 p.m. Central. You give up very little by buying the older model.

The XM5 still has some of the best noise cancellation you can buy, using eight microphones and two processors, and it stays comfortable on long flights thanks to its light frame and soft ear pads. Call quality is strong for over-ear headphones, and Best Buy shoppers rate it 4.6 out of 5 across thousands of reviews.

Check the SKU before you check out: other colors and bundles are listed separately and may not carry the same price. If you want the newest version, the XM6 is on the same page for a good deal more. If you mostly listen at a desk and want huge battery life, the Nothing Headphone (a) at Target is worth comparing.
deals.who_for: Frequent flyers, commuters and open-office workers who want quiet.
deals.skip_if: You want the very latest model, or you need headphones that fold small for a bag.

deals.title: Oura Ring 5
deals.blurb: The smallest Oura yet: all titanium, with sleep, heart-rate and temperature tracking and close to a week per charge. It needs a paid membership, and you should use the sizing kit first.
deals.label: Gift idea
write_up: The Oura Ring 5 is the smallest Oura yet, and it is on sale at Best Buy through Saturday, November 28, with the same deal at Target and Amazon. Oura's own site is running its discount through November 30 if you miss the Best Buy window.

It's an all-titanium ring that tracks sleep, heart rate, temperature trends and activity, with Best Buy listing more than 50 health measurements in all. Battery life is rated at six to nine days per charge, far longer than most smartwatches, and the ring is designed to be worn around the clock, including in bed, which is where most of its useful data comes from.

Two things to know before you buy. First, most features need a paid Oura membership, so budget for that on top of the ring. Second, use the included sizing kit before you choose a size. Oura sizes don't match standard US ring sizes and they differ from older Oura generations, so even your old Oura size may be wrong. Pick the size and finish on the product page.
deals.who_for: People who care about sleep and recovery but don't want a watch on their wrist.
deals.skip_if: You don't want another subscription, or you need on-screen notifications.

deals.title: Google Home Speaker with Gemini for Home
deals.blurb: Google's new smart speaker runs Gemini, so you can ask for several things at once and it copes. 360-degree sound, and two of them pair with a Google TV Streamer. Each color has its own listing.
deals.label: Ends Nov 28

deals.title: Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle
deals.blurb: The Switch 2 bundle with Mario Kart World is a Best Buy Doorbuster at $499.99, the same price as the console on its own. It's the easiest big family gift of the season.
deals.label: Doorbuster
write_up: Best Buy has the Nintendo Switch 2 bundled with Mario Kart World as a Doorbuster at $499.99, against a usual $549.99. That is the same price Best Buy lists for the Switch 2 system by itself today, so in practice the game comes free. Target lists the bundle at $499.99 on its Black Friday deals page too, and Tom's Guide reports the same price at Amazon, so this is the going rate this week rather than a one-store blip.

This is for anyone who has been waiting for a sale before buying a Switch 2, and for families shopping for one big shared gift. Mario Kart World is the kind of game that gets everyone on the couch, from young kids to grandparents. If you already own a Switch 2, skip it; the bundle saves you nothing on the game alone.

Before you buy, check what you are getting. In many Switch 2 bundles the game comes as a download code rather than a cartridge, which matters if you like to trade or lend games. Make sure the listing says it is sold and shipped by Best Buy, and read the return terms on the product page before you buy it as a gift.

If a console is more than you want to spend, the LEGO Polaroid OneStep SX-70 set on our site is a calmer gift for an older kid or adult. For tech gifts at a lower price, the Apple AirTag 2nd gen and the Kindle Paperwhite are both on sale too.
deals.who_for: Families and gamers buying their first Switch 2 who want a game everyone can play.
deals.skip_if: You already own a Switch 2, or you only want the game.

deals.title: TCL 65" S4CF Series 4K UHD HDR Smart TV with Fire TV (2026)
deals.blurb: A 2026 TCL 65-inch 4K TV with Fire TV built in, a Best Buy Doorbuster at $229.99. It's a budget set, but it's hard to get this much screen for less.
deals.label: Doorbuster
write_up: Best Buy has TCL's 65-inch S4CF, the 2026 model, as a Doorbuster at $229.99, down from a comparable value of $469.99. That is a very low price for a screen this size from a brand with a long record in budget TVs.

This TV suits a guest room, a basement, a dorm or a first apartment, anywhere the goal is a big picture without a big bill. Fire TV is built in, so you get the main streaming apps without a separate stick, and voice control works through the remote.

Be realistic about what this money buys. The S4 is TCL's entry series. It is not a QLED or mini-LED set, so it will not get as bright or show as much contrast as TCL's higher series, and it is not aimed at fast competitive gaming. If you watch a lot of movies in a dark room, you will notice the difference. Before you check out, confirm the model says S4CF and 2026, check that the listing is sold by Best Buy, and measure your wall or stand: a 65-inch TV is about 57 inches wide.
If you want better picture quality, step up to a QLED or mini-LED model, which costs more. For a gaming setup in the same room, the Nintendo Switch 2 bundle is also a Best Buy Doorbuster this week.
deals.who_for: Anyone who wants a big 4K screen for a spare room, dorm or first apartment on a tight budget.
deals.skip_if: You watch movies in a dark room and care most about contrast and brightness.

deals.title: Dyson V9 Motorbar Cordless Vacuum
deals.blurb: A new Dyson V9 Motorbar, sold by Dyson's own store on Walmart, is a Black Friday Deal at $269.95. Its head is built to stop hair wrapping, which pet owners will notice.
deals.label: Black Friday Deal
write_up: Walmart has the Dyson V9 Motorbar marked as a Black Friday Deal at $269.95, with a listed former price of $599.99. The seller is Dyson, Inc. through its own store on Walmart, not a third-party reseller, and the item is listed as new.

The V9 is a few generations old, but it is still a proper Dyson stick vacuum. Dyson rates it for up to 40 minutes of suction, and the Motorbar head is designed to clear hair from the brush bar as you clean, which helps a lot with long hair and pets. It converts into a handheld for stairs, cars and sofas.

Check the listing carefully, because Walmart shows several V9 Motorbar items side by side. One is a Restored unit and another is sold without the manufacturer's warranty. The deal we mean is the new nickel model sold by Dyson, Inc. Look at the return terms on the product page too, since marketplace sellers can set their own.

If you would rather not push a vacuum at all, the Roborock Q7 M5+ robot vacuum and mop on our site handles daily upkeep on its own. For a smaller gift for the kitchen, the Crock-Pot 7-quart slow cooker is also on sale at Walmart.
deals.who_for: Pet owners and anyone with long hair who wants a light, proper cordless vacuum.
deals.skip_if: You want the newest Dyson features, or you would rather a robot did the work.

deals.title: Shark DePuffi Instant Hot + Cold Contrast Therapy Tool
deals.hook: Hot and Cold Face Tool Gift
deals.blurb: Shark's hot-and-cold face tool is $149.99 at Best Buy, $50 off. It is one of the more talked-about beauty gifts this year, and Ulta has the same price.
deals.label: Gift idea
write_up: Best Buy has the Shark DePuffi at $149.99 as a Black Friday Deal, $50 under its usual $199.99. NBC Select's Thanksgiving roundup lists the same price at Best Buy, Ulta and Amazon, so this looks like the going sale price everywhere rather than a one-store blip.

The DePuffi is a handheld facial tool that switches between cold and warm settings, with six temperature levels and an edge shaped like a gua sha stone. The idea is a quick morning routine to calm puffiness and relax tense muscles in the face and neck. It comes with a travel case and charger, which makes it an easy gift to wrap.

It is a gift for the person who already enjoys a skincare routine and likes trying new gadgets. Be clear about what it is: a comfort and routine tool, not a medical device, and results are modest and temporary. Skip it for someone who never uses face tools.

Check delivery before you order. Best Buy showed store pickup as unavailable and delivery in early December, which is fine for Christmas but not for a gift you need this weekend. For a styling gift instead, the Shark FlexStyle on our site is also on sale, and the Oral-B iO3 at Target is a practical pick.
deals.who_for: Skincare fans who like new tools and want a calm morning routine.
deals.skip_if: The person never uses face tools, or you need it delivered this weekend.

deals.title: Crock-Pot Manual 7-Quart Slow Cooker
deals.blurb: A plain, big Crock-Pot with three settings and room for a whole roast or a party batch of chili. Walmart has it as a Rollback at $31.98 in Mussel Grey; other colors cost more.
deals.label: Rollback

deals.title: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite 16GB (2024)
deals.blurb: The current Paperwhite has a 7-inch glare-free screen, a water-resistant body and weeks of battery. It's one of the easiest gifts for a reader, and Amazon has it in its Black Friday sale.
deals.label: Gift idea

deals.title: Target Black Friday Sale
deals.blurb: Target's Black Friday deals are live now and run through November 29. Toys, clothing, headphones, TVs and Apple gear are all in it, with some online-only deals that change daily.
deals.label: Ends Nov 29

deals.title: Walmart Black Friday Deals & More
deals.blurb: Walmart's Black Friday Deals & More event is live online, with vacuums, kitchen gear, TVs and toys marked down. Check who the seller is, since marketplace listings sit beside Walmart's own.
deals.label: Live now
